vocabulary.meaning_en: one of the twelve parts of a year
vocabulary.note_en: Say /mʌnθ/; it ends with a th sound.

vocabulary.note_ar: انتبه للنطق: /mʌnθs/ بصوت ث ثم س
vocabulary.note_en: Careful with pronunciation: /mʌnθs/, th then s.
vocabulary.example: There are twelve months in a year.
There are twelve months in a year.

vocabulary.note_ar: أسماء الشهور تبدأ دائمًا بحرف كبير
vocabulary.note_en: Months always start with a capital letter.

vocabulary.note_ar: تُنطق غالبًا /ˈfebjuəri/ والحرف r الأول خفيف
vocabulary.note_en: Usually said /ˈfebjuəri/; the first r is often soft.

vocabulary.example: I like eating mangoes in August.

vocabulary.note_ar: الشهور من September إلى December تنتهي بـ ber
vocabulary.note_en: September to December all end in -ber.
vocabulary.example: December is the last month of the year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: soft white ice that falls from the sky

vocabulary.example: There are a lot of flowers in spring.
I like eating mangoes in summer.
The winter months are December, January and February.
The spring months are March, April and May.
The summer months are June, July and August.
The fall months are September, October and November.

fine_lines.title: month vs months
fine_lines.explanation_ar: month مفرد ينتهي بصوت ث، و months جمع ينتهي بصوت ث ثم س. لا تنطقها (مانس) فقط.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Month ends with a th sound; months ends with th + s. Say both sounds.

examples.sentence: There are twelve months in a year.

fine_lines.title: March vs May
fine_lines.explanation_ar: March شهر 3 (مارس)، و May شهر 5 (مايو). كلاهما يبدأ بحرف M ومن شهور الربيع.
fine_lines.explanation_en: March is month 3 and May is month 5. Both start with M and are spring months.

fine_lines.title: June vs July
fine_lines.explanation_ar: June شهر 6 (يونيو)، و July شهر 7 (يوليو). كلاهما يبدأ بـ Ju ومن شهور الصيف.
fine_lines.explanation_en: June is month 6 and July is month 7. Both start with Ju and are summer months.

fine_lines.title: before vs after
fine_lines.explanation_ar: before = قبل، و after = بعد. نستخدمهما لترتيب الشهور.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Before means earlier and after means later. Use them for the order of months.

expressions.phrase: There are twelve months in a year.
expressions.meaning_ar: توجد اثنا عشر شهرًا في السنة.
expressions.example: There are twelve months in a year. January is the first.

expressions.meaning_en: Talking about the order of months.
expressions.example: February comes after January and before March.
We start school in September and finish in June.

expressions.meaning_en: Saying the month of your birthday.
expressions.example: My birthday is in May. It's in spring.

expressions.phrase: The winter months are December, January and February.
expressions.meaning_ar: شهور الشتاء هي ديسمبر ويناير وفبراير.
expressions.meaning_en: Naming the months of a season.
expressions.example: The winter months are December, January and February. It's cold and rainy.

expressions.phrase: It's very hot and sunny in July.
expressions.meaning_ar: الجو حار جدًا ومشمس في يوليو.
expressions.meaning_en: Describing the weather in a month.
expressions.example: It's very hot and sunny in July, so we go to the beach.

grammar.title: Months start with a capital letter
grammar.explanation_ar: أسماء الشهور في الإنجليزية تبدأ دائمًا بحرف كبير، حتى في وسط الجملة.
grammar.explanation_en: Months always start with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
examples: Wrong: in october. Right: in October.

grammar.title: in + month
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم in قبل اسم الشهر وقبل اسم الفصل.
grammar.explanation_en: Use in before a month and before a season.

grammar.title: The months in order with before and after
grammar.explanation_ar: ترتيب الشهور: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December. ترتيبها حقيقة فنستخدم المضارع البسيط comes لأن الشهر مفرد.
grammar.explanation_en: Order: January to December. The order is a fact, so use the present simple: comes (a month is singular).

grammar.title: Months and seasons
grammar.explanation_ar: لكل فصل ثلاثة شهور: الشتاء December, January, February، الربيع March, April, May، الصيف June, July, August، الخريف September, October, November. ونصف الطقس بـ It's.
grammar.explanation_en: Each season has three months: winter (Dec–Feb), spring (Mar–May), summer (Jun–Aug), fall (Sep–Nov). Describe the weather with It's.
examples: The spring months are March, April and May.
It's warm and sunny in April.
It's cool and cloudy in October.

questions.question: How many months are there in a year?
questions.explanation_en: There are twelve months in a year.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: الشهر يبدأ بحرف كبير ونستخدم in قبله.
questions.explanation_en: Months start with a capital letter, and we use in.

questions.question: November comes ___ December.
questions.explanation_en: November is earlier than December, so before.

questions.question: Which are the spring months?
questions.explanation_en: The spring months are March, April and May.

questions.question: We start school ___ September.
questions.explanation_en: We use in before a month.

questions.question: It's snowy in ___.
questions.explanation_ar: يناير من شهور الشتاء، أما البقية فمن شهور الصيف.
questions.explanation_en: January is a winter month; the others are summer months.

questions.question: What is the last month of the year?
"Snowy" means ___
questions.explanation_en: Snowy comes from snow: with a lot of snow.
